name: Scene Partner
description:
**Subclass Feature**

Whenever you use the Brag, Flirt, Persuade, Music, Perform, or Read Person skill on a test while interacting with an NPC (a bystander, a rival, and so forth) and you don't fail the test, you can form a bond with that NPC. If you then enter into a negotiation with this NPC, their patience increases by 1, and any compelling arguments you personally make to the NPC that would increase their interest by 1 instead increase their interest by 2. You can have 1 bond, losing a bond of your choice whenever you make a new bond beyond your limit.
